purpose: Bounded comparison for Q7 IpuSubmit output descriptor selection and HDR final FIPLIB matrix numeric generation
method: Read committed blobs with git show at the fixed public commit; ignored dirty local worktree content. SHA-256 values below were computed from those exact blob bytes.

claims.topic: JPEG output descriptor and selection boundary
claims.claim: K-3 JPEG evidence maps output descriptor +0 to the coded-output buffer address; MMIO write site 0x5320c4d0 stores it at 0x298c0440. Descriptor +8 is capacity, and 0x5320c4e4 writes capacity >> 9 to 0x298c0458 on the full-resolution path but zero on the prepass path. This establishes a capacity/control branch, not which output descriptor IpuSubmit selected or that it aliases an ISP output buffer. Completion reads code length from 0x298c0020; descriptor +0xc is recorded as actual output length after completion.

K-3 color evidence describes configuration-matrix preparation at 0x5312ce30: T=Mul16_Q13(F,M); U=(ColorSpace condition ? Mul16_Q13(A,T) : T); V=Mul32_Q13(sign_extend(U),sign_extend(B)). The effective ColorSpace flag P52 is one exactly when common+0x26b5==1; it selects optional A and also affects YCbCr coefficients and gamma preparation. Saturation selection uses 0..8 with fallback index 4; filter value 9 selects the manual-RGB branch. The report explicitly limits this to coefficient preparation, not pixel-pass order. This K-3 evidence is not an HDR-specific FIPLIB execution trace.
evidence: analysis/deep-evidence.json: color/matrix ranges and conditional bindings

claims.claim: The committed color-math checks report 942 isolated ARM/reference comparisons: 170 kernels, 690 matrix-preparation cases, 64 output-packing cases, and 18 Hue cases. Inputs are synthetic and execution is limited to listed code ranges; the suite does not execute the camera or ISP peripherals. The HTML also states that the physical input RGB primaries/transfer function and pixel-processing order remain unresolved. Thus it validates selected coefficient/configuration arithmetic, not final HDR pixels, FIPLIB runtime pass selection, DMA, or output image correctness.
evidence: analysis/color-algorithms.html: section 색 행렬·채도·색상 조절 and its execution/limits paragraph

explicit_unknowns: K-3 public evidence does not establish which output descriptor the Q7 IpuSubmit analogue selects; model-specific addresses and branch predicates must be traced independently.
The K-3 matrix preparation path is not evidence that Q7 uses the same stages, coefficients, or FIPLIB semantics, and does not establish HDR pixel math or final pixel-pass ordering.
No camera/peripheral execution, DMA/cache behavior, or final image correctness is verified by the cited numeric checks.
